instruction: Keep going to the next song on Spotify until you reach a song I have already downloaded.
notes: Single-app task (spotify). The music-player queue is abstracted as a cyclic chain of song objects with static (queue-next ?s1 ?s2) facts, a (cursor-at ?s) state fact and static (downloaded ?s) facts; the concrete problem uses a 3-song queue where the current song and the next one are not downloaded and the third is, so the plan needs two next_song calls (matching the 7-call reference). Knowledge gating: show_downloaded_songs sets (downloads-known) and show_song_queue sets (queue-known); next_song requires both and additionally (not (downloaded ?from)), which encodes 'keep going until you reach a downloaded song' and prevents overshooting. supervisor.complete_task takes no answer; its extra non-API parameter ?s is the song the cursor must rest on, with precondition (cursor-at ?s) and (downloaded ?s); goal demands the cursor on the downloaded song plus (task-completed). At runtime the agent compares the current song id (from show_song_queue / show_current_song after each next_song) against the downloaded song ids to decide when to stop; the initial song is not downloaded so at least one next_song happens, matching the evaluation's expectation that only MusicPlayer.cursor_position changes.
